headline_seed: Panama rocked by 2 powerful earthquakes and multiple aftershocks, prompting evacuations - AP News
draft_text:
#BreakingMews A magnitude 7.7 quake struck Panama Friday, per USGS. NBC News reports tsunami warnings issued for Colombia, Ecuador, Nicaragua, and Guatemala. ~4.6 million felt moderate-to-severe shaking, per Axios.

And that's the mews.
